title: Root-origin detection in mesh_to_mesh misses the root's native 02xx source address
description: Found by 3x codereview of b7z9.4.1 (passes: correctness). gateway.rs is_root_origin compares ipv6[8..24] only against the root's link-local address, so a root-originated packet whose src is the root's native 0200::/8 address (normal src for app unicast per spec 6.1/12, e.g. gateway-originated CoAP via TUN) falls into the IPv6-in-IPv6 tunnel branch instead of the inline-SRH branch, and now receives the extra -1 forwarding decrement that spec 05-routing 8.9 reserves for packets the root forwards. Benign today (HL=64 origins, guard never trips) but a spec-precision deviation. Fix: extend is_root_origin to also match the root's native 02xx address (needs a root-native-address accessor on the node id / DODAG), or compute the forwarding decrement as u8::from(!is_root_origin). Add a test pinning src=root-native-02xx behavior. Files: rust/lichen-gateway/src/gateway.rs (~1649), possibly lichen-node node-id accessors. Discovered from project-LICHEN-worker6-b7z9.4.1.
